prompt_text: Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation sprite sheet chr_brasa_strong. Output exactly 1536x1024 PNG. Image 1: gameplay STYLE reference. Image 2: Brasa IDENTITY anchor only; do not copy its background RGB. BRASA: athletic adult woman, medium brown skin, dark-brown high ponytail, orange forehead headband with loose tails, graphite crop top with orange details, large orange and graphite mechanical gauntlets, orange and graphite cargo pants, orange boots with white soles. Exactly preserve the anchor's face, proportions, outfit, colors and gauntlet design. Animation: heavy side strike: big anticipation twist, step in, smear frame, full-extension impact pose with a bright white-core star flash at the fist (frame 5), follow-through, recovery ×2, back to guard. Brasa has no scarf; use ponytail and headband tails. Her attack effects where requested are orange fire/impact on the gauntlets. Warm sunset lighting from the left, orange rim light. No other fighters, held objects, shield bubbles, or stun stars.  Exactly 8 poses: anticipation twist, step in, smear, extended approach, full impact white-core flash on frame 5, follow-through, recovery, guard. Exactly 8 distinct consecutive animation frames, a single sheet. Maintain strict lateral profile and generous margin below feet: grounded baseline at y=450 within every 512px cell. Transparent background with real alpha; if impossible uniform pure magenta #FF00FF, never brown or gradient. Sprite sheet for a 2D side-view fighting game. Strict side view, character facing RIGHT in every frame. Grid of 4 columns × 2 rows, 8 equal cells, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom as frames 1 to 8 of ONE continuous animation. The SAME character in every cell: identical proportions, costume, colors and scale; only the pose changes, with smooth in-between motion from one frame to the next. Feet (or lowest point when grounded) on the same baseline at 88% of the cell height; the character's body centered horizontally in each cell; nothing crosses cell borders. Clean cel-shaded anime illustration matching the reference image: thick dark outline (#15101C), two-tone flat shading, crisp rim light in the character's accent color. Fully transparent background (if transparency is impossible, flat pure magenta #FF00FF with no gradient and no shadow). No grid lines, no frame numbers, no text, no ground, no drop shadow, no effects outside the character unless the prompt asks for them.
